common.unsavedLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

cities.title: Destinations
cities.description: A destination is a city page customers browse (/stays/city/…). It only appears once it has at least one published stay.
cities.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and -, e.g. shiraz. Becomes /stays/city/shiraz.
cities.name: Name
cities.intro: Introduction (shown on the city page, good for search engines)

properties.title: Hotels and stays
properties.importTitle: Import a hotel already on Lsevin
properties.importHint: Creates a DRAFT from the provider's name, description, address, photos and nightly rooms. Review it before publishing. A provider can be imported once.
properties.empty: No stays yet. Create one or import an existing hotel.
properties.providerSearch: Type at least 2 letters of the provider name
properties.inventoryRooms: By rooms (hotel: several rooms of each type)
properties.inventoryEntire: As a whole place (one unit: villa, suite, apartment)

create.intro: Enter just the essentials. After creating it you go to the full editor to add rooms, photos and prices.
create.phoneHint: Optional. Shown on the stay page and used for the provider.
create.slugHint: The name sets the initial address. You can edit it. Public page: {path}
create.slugTaken: Another stay already uses this address. Choose a different one.
create.ownerIntro: Every stay belongs to a provider; bookings and payouts go through it. You don't need to create one first.
create.ownerAutoHint: A provider with the same name, city and phone is created.
create.ownerExistingHint: When this hotel belongs to a provider that is already registered.
create.ownerLogin: Owner account for the provider panel (optional)
create.ownerLoginHint: Email or mobile number of a registered Lsevin user. If given, this hotel shows in their provider panel. You can leave it empty.
create.ownerLoginNotFound: No user with this email or number. They must sign up on Lsevin first, or leave this empty.
create.created: Stay created. Now add rooms, photos and prices.

editor.archiveHint: Archived stays can never come back. Existing bookings stay valid.

req.room_type: At least one active room type
req.entire_place_one_unit: A whole place needs exactly one active unit

editor.slugHint: Changing it changes the public address.
editor.name: Name
editor.summary: Short summary (shown in results and search engines)
editor.accessibilityNotVerified: Not checked yet; customers see it as the host's statement.
editor.currencyLocked: Cannot change after the first booking.
editor.staleEdit: Someone else saved this stay meanwhile. Reload to see their changes, then edit again.

rooms.title: Room types
rooms.hint: A room type is what guests book (e.g. Double room). Units = how many identical rooms of this type you sell each night.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.deleteHint: Only a room type that was never booked can be deleted. Otherwise switch off “On sale”.
rooms.deleteConfirm: Delete this room type and its rates?

plans.title: Rates
plans.hint: Rates of the same room type share its rooms. Prices are per room per night for the included guests.
plans.name: Name (optional)

calendar.title: Availability and prices
calendar.legend: Each day: units left (sold + held) and the price of each rate. Red = closed.
calendar.unitsHint: Leave empty to keep. Cannot go below what is already booked.
calendar.priceHint: Empty = back to the rate's normal price.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Landscape photos, 1600 px wide or more, WebP/JPEG under ~500 KB. Only photos you have the right to use. The first photo is the cover.
photos.alt: Description (required, for screen readers and search engines)

policy.title: Cancellation policy
policy.hint: Saving creates a NEW version. Existing bookings keep the version they accepted.
policy.rule: Refund {percent, number}% if cancelled at least {hours, number} hours before check-in

bookings.title: Stay bookings
bookings.revealHint: Every reveal is recorded with your reason (10+ characters).

reviews.title: Guest reviews
reviews.hint: Moderation only changes visibility. A guest's words and score are never edited.

errors.publish_requirements: Not ready to publish yet. Complete the items listed under “Before publishing”.
errors.archived_is_final: An archived stay cannot be changed.
errors.room_has_bookings: This room type has bookings. Switch off “On sale” instead.
errors.rate_plan_has_bookings: This rate has bookings. Switch off “On sale” instead.
errors.entire_place_needs_one_unit: A whole place can have only one active unit.
errors.currency_locked: The currency cannot change after the first booking.
errors.stale_edit: Someone else saved this stay meanwhile. Reload and edit again.
errors.city_has_properties: This destination has stays. Unpublish it instead.
errors.last_photo: A published stay needs at least one photo.
errors.room_photo_cannot_be_cover: Only a photo of the whole property can be the cover.
errors.units_below_booked: Some nights already have more bookings than that.
errors.invalid_settings: A setting is out of range.
errors.not_requested: This booking is not waiting for an answer any more.
errors.not_cancellable: This booking can no longer be cancelled.
errors.duplicate: That address (slug) or code is already used.
errors.no_accommodation_provider_type: No accommodation provider type exists. Add one under Provider types first.
errors.invalid_parent: Choose a main amenity as the parent of an option.
errors.amenity_has_options: This amenity has options; remove them before making it an option.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.intro: Everything a hotel or room can offer. Names are shown to guests in their own language; an image, if set, replaces the icon.
amenities.name: Name
amenities.optionOfHint: Make this a choice under another amenity, e.g. “Key card” under “Door lock type”.
amenities.hasOptionsHint: This amenity has options, so it cannot itself become an option.
amenities.sectionHint: Where guests see it. Rooms can only have amenities from the room, bathroom and accessibility sections.
amenities.sectionFromParent: Options always use the section of their amenity.
amenities.iconHint: Shown next to the name when there is no image.
amenities.imageHint: Optional. A small square picture (transparent PNG, SVG or WebP) that replaces the icon.
amenities.orderHint: Smaller numbers come first within the section.
amenities.activeHint: Switched-off amenities disappear for admins and guests; hotels keep their selection.
amenities.usage: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used by # hotel or room} other {Used by # hotels and rooms}}
amenities.empty: Choose an amenity on the left to edit it.
amenities.missingLanguages: {count, plural, one {# language without a name} other {# languages without a name}}
amenities.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
